walkthrough: Goal: V大's weeks 3 and 4 assignment, 几何体 + 点定位 概括单体: an object copied by simplifying it into its box, the box found first, then big to small, every point with a reason; then the object's exact visible edges over my drawing, judged by my eye: nothing of my strokes is read (S145).

Entry: a lesson of Objects from the home holds one object: at level 1 a block or a round one in turn, at level 2 a cut or a taper, at level 3 a round or a taper. The first lesson here is at level 2: a box cut by a slope (a cut).

Objects: its How shows first. Title: An object simplified into boxes; Weeks 3 and 4 · an object simplified into boxes beside its picture: the box first, then big to small, every point found by a reason. The example plays at a hand's pace beside its picture (a box with a slope cut down its far end and a notch out of its near corner, seen from above and lit from one side; its own fixed seed, never an exercise's): the box's nine other edges in pencil; the slope's points found by a face's diagonal and the thirds and heights measured on the near upright, its construction dark while it is found; then the notch's the same way, the slope's construction gone faint and the notch's dark; the visible edges in ink; then Compare: the visible edges in see-through red over the hand's ink, the construction faint under them. Cropped at 100 % the card's example reads: the step being found dark, the steps before faint. Steps: 1 Complete the box with Sketch, 2 The biggest cut first: its points by halves and thirds, 3 Then the smaller part; a round one's square and ellipse, 4 The visible edges with Draw, 5 Compare. One paragraph says to find each point on the box's surface or inside it, never in the air, no details, and to redraw a wrong edge once with Correct. Got it.

The exercise: the left frame holds the object's picture, a solid lit from one side on the paper, the top lightest, the sides two values, no lines. My frame holds the horizon (labelled) and the box's front corner with its three edges in ink, at the picture's angle. The tools: Sketch, Draw, Undo, Redo. Here a box with a slope cut along its top, seen from above the horizon.

I complete its box with Sketch (the nine other edges), then with Draw its visible edges, but I put the cut a little too high on the front face (a mistake): the cut's lower line and its two slanted edges, and the two uprights up to it.

Compare: the object's visible edges in red as thick as my pen and see-through over my ink, the cut's three a little above the red; nothing of mine is read, ringed or run on. The left frame now shows over the picture the whole box in pencil (its hidden edges dashed) and V大's construction in dashed pencil, the corners it finds ringed. The card: Construction, How close is it?, Accurate, Almost, Again. The pen is blue (Correct): I draw the cut's lower line, its two slanted edges and the two uprights again on the red and Compare: my correction on the red. I choose Accurate, kept once; no number is kept. Undo and Redo as any stroke.
Finish: the lesson's end, Objects, 1 exercise, its dot. That's all for today; a lesson of Objects at level 1 lays the next object; Finish, That's all for today: the home.
